evals.name: ranked-multi-archetype-proposals
evals.setup: The project calls `must.Value` at 34 sites, 28 of them wrapped in the same three-line error-drop, and builds the same options struct inline at 12 more. The library is a local module under a `replace` directive, so its source is editable.

evals.name: proposals-stay-on-the-library
evals.setup: `oskit` is consumed across the module, but the run is scoped to `./pkg/render`. `oskit`'s source sits in the module cache with no `replace` and no `go.work` entry, so it is external. Several call sites could be tidied without touching `oskit` at all — the tempting wrong answer.

evals.name: external-library-public-surface
evals.setup: `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` is an ordinary module dependency: no `replace`, no `go.work` entry, source in the module cache.

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A run whose analysis would support eight proposals, capped at three.

evals.name: restraint-on-an-api-that-is-fine
evals.setup: A small library the consumer uses cleanly: 9 call sites, no repeated wrapper, no inline config building, no re-declared interface, no error-string matching. Nothing about the consuming code is obviously improvable by changing the library.
